trend.title: Transaction Status
trend.orderPayPriceTip: Actual payment amount for products purchased by users, including WeChat Pay, balance payment, Alipay, offline payment (group purchase products are counted after the group is formed, offline payment orders are counted after payment is confirmed in the background)
trend.expensePriceTip: Balance payment amount, brokerage payment amount, product refund amount
trend.walletPayPriceTip: Actual amount paid by users using balance when placing orders
trend.brokerageSettlementPriceTip: Promotion commission paid by the backend to promoters, based on actual payment
trend.afterSaleRefundPriceTip: Product amount successfully refunded by users

summary.title: Product Overview
summary.browseCountTip: Under selected conditions, the number of times all product detail pages are visited. One person visiting multiple times within the statistical period is counted multiple times
summary.browseUserCountTip: Under selected conditions, the number of people who visited any product detail page. One person visiting multiple times within the statistical period is counted only once
summary.orderPayCountTip: Under selected conditions, the sum of product quantities in successfully paid orders
summary.orderPayPriceTip: Under selected conditions, the sum of product amounts in successfully paid orders
summary.afterSaleCountTip: Under selected conditions, the sum of product quantities successfully refunded
summary.afterSaleRefundPriceTip: Under selected conditions, the sum of product amounts successfully refunded
